title.en: Had it not been for the rain

es: Reconocer contrafactuales con inversión (had it not been for, had we known) y su equivalente con if.

title.en: Were it not for, but for, as if
title.es: Si no fuera por, salvo por

es: Formar were it not for, but for, without y as if / as though con el tiempo irreal adecuado en frases sobre decisiones vitales.

teaching.en: Were it not for my mentor, I would still be unsure about my career.
teaching.es: Si no fuera por mi mentora, seguiría sin tener claro mi futuro profesional.
teaching.explanationEs: Were it not for + nombre equivale a If it weren't for: presente irreal, con would + verbo.
segments: Were it not for my mentor, I
would still be unsure about my career.

teaching.en: But for her encouragement, he would never have applied for the scholarship.
teaching.es: De no ser por su ánimo, nunca habría solicitado la beca.
teaching.explanationEs: But for + nombre sirve para presente o pasado; no lleva verbo propio.
segments: But for her encouragement, he would
never have applied for the scholarship.
teaching.audioText: But for her encouragement, he would never have applied for the scholarship.

answer.text: At twenty-five, I left my hometown to study design in Lima, although I had a safe job. Had I stayed, I would have kept my salary, but I would never have pursued my passion. But for my courage, I would probably still be working in the same office. Were it not for that risk, my life would be much smaller today, and I would not be as happy as I am now. In hindsight, leaving was the turning point of my life. The decision was difficult, but it was worthwhile, and I am proud that I was brave enough to take it.

When I was twenty-five, I decided to leave my hometown and study design in Lima, even though I had a safe job. answer.text: Last week I bought a second-hand bike without checking it, and now it has problems. I wish I had been more careful. If only I hadn't been so impulsive, I would still have my savings. I should have asked a sensible friend to come with me, and I could have tried to convince the seller to lower the price. If I were you, Tom, I would consult a mechanic before buying anything. In hindsight, it was a useful lesson.
